# importfromchina.shop

> Single-item import service from China to Pakistan. A buyer sends one product link through the quote form at https://importfromchina.shop/#quote, receives one delivered price on WhatsApp in Pakistani rupees within 24 hours (item, shipping, customs and our fee, with the fee stated upfront), pays once before the item ships, and receives it at any address in Pakistan in 7 to 15 days after the seller dispatches. One item per order. No bulk, wholesale or resale stock. Shipping from China usually costs Rs 5,000 to 20,000 depending on the item's size and type, plus the service fee, so the service makes sense for items worth around Rs 10,000 or more.

Key facts:
- Sources: Alibaba, 1688, Taobao, AliExpress and other Chinese marketplaces.
- Payment: bank transfer, Raast, JazzCash or Easypaisa, in rupees, once, before shipping. Nothing to pay on delivery.
- Contact: WhatsApp +92 300 0258981, or the quote form on the homepage. Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/importfromchinatopakistan/
- Refunds: full refund if the item has not arrived within 10 days after the agreed delivery date, or arrives wrong, damaged or not working. Details: https://importfromchina.shop/refund-policy/
- About us: https://importfromchina.shop/about/

## Glossary
- [What Is DDP Shipping? Meaning for Pakistani Buyers](https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-is-ddp-shipping): DDP means Delivered Duty Paid: the seller delivers to your door with Pakistan customs cleared and duty paid. What it covers, what it leaves out, when it helps.
- [What Is Volumetric Weight and How Is It Calculated?](https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-is-volumetric-weight): Volumetric weight explained with worked examples in cm and kg. DHL, FedEx and UPS divide by 5,000, air freight by 6,000. How chargeable weight is set.
- [What Is MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) on Alibaba and 1688?](https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-is-moq): MOQ means minimum order quantity, the fewest units a seller will sell in one order. How it shows on Alibaba and 1688, and how to find single-piece listings.
- [What Is CIF Value? How Pakistan Customs Values Your Parcel](https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-is-cif-value-customs-pakistan): CIF value is the item price plus freight and insurance to Pakistan. How section 25 of the Customs Act sets it, when valuation rulings apply, with an example.
- [What Is the De Minimis Limit for Parcels in Pakistan?](https://importfromchina.shop/blog/what-is-de-minimis-customs-pakistan): Pakistan's de minimis limit is Rs 1,000 for post and courier parcels under section 19C, cut from Rs 5,000 by the Finance Act 2025, and unchanged in 2026.
